title: Pending index age
description: Oldest currently eligible unprocessed knowledge index intent, with backlog and exhausted failures. Zero age when none. Snapshot metric; the requested window does not filter backlog.
formula: max(now - created_at) for eligible unprocessed non-exhausted intents; zero if empty

title: Candidate validation rate
description: Passing latest completed report per candidate version among reports completed in the half-open UTC window. No reports produces null, not zero. Failed verifier attempts without completed reports are observable in traces but excluded.
formula: passing latest reports / latest completed reports

title: Candidate approval rate
description: Approve decisions divided by all approve and reject decisions in the half-open UTC window. Idempotent retries do not create decisions. Empty denominator is null.

title: Validated reuse rate
description: Completed tasks with trusted passing local validation and explicitly recorded eligible used context divided by completed locally validated tasks. A search hit alone is not reuse. Eight of twenty is 0.4 (40%). This is observational, not causal attribution.
formula: locally validated completed tasks with used_context / locally validated completed tasks
preconditions: explicit context-use receipt and action-time eligibility

title: Governed software knowledge
description: PostgreSQL owns exact versions, sources, validations and accountable decisions. Milvus is a replaceable semantic candidate projection; all results must be hydrated and quality checked.

title: Promote validated knowledge
description: knowledge_candidate_decide is implemented by Service.DecideKnowledge with the versioned decision contract. TestKnowledgePromotionTransactionIntegration in internal/postgres/validation_integration_test.go validates its storage invariants. Registry validation is not a claim that this integration test just ran.
output_contract: knowledge item exact version and approval receipt
idempotency: knowledge ID plus key; changed payload conflicts
reversibility: approval history is immutable; invalid knowledge is quarantined
compensation: revalidate a new version; retry failed projection after resolving cause
